ferrailleur.label: 🔧 Repair the ship
ferrailleur.message: He glances at the hull and pulls out his tools. -500 cr · Ship repaired ({{max}}/{{max}} HP).

medecin.label: 💊 Full treatment
medecin.message: -300 cr · Full treatment. HP restored to {{max}}.

hackeuse.label: ⚡ Wipe the record
hackeuse.message: -800 cr · She types a few lines without looking at you. "Done." +40 reputation.

dealer.label: 📦 Under-the-table supplies
dealer.message: -400 cr · He pulls a crate out from under the counter. +2 Medicine · +1 Stimulant.

forgeron.label: ⚔ Upgrade equipped weapon
forgeron.message: He reworks the blade in silence. -400 cr · -Tools ×2 · {{weapon}}: +2 min/max damage.

piloteRetraite.label: 🛸 Secret route
piloteRetraite.message: -200 cr · "Take this shortcut — nobody else knows about it yet." +2 fuel.

veteran.label: 🏋 Intensive training
veteran.message: An hour with him. No words, just sweat. Stamina maxed · +8 reputation.

courtier.label: 💼 Discreet deal
courtier.message: -500 cr · He slides a crate across the counter. +1 {{item}}.

marchande.label: 💼 Exclusive stock
marchande.message: -400 cr · "Just came in, not even in the catalog yet." +1 {{item}}.

chercheuse.label: 🔬 Artifact / data appraisal
chercheuse.whyNotNone: No data or artifact in cargo (Data, Stolen data, Artifacts…)
chercheuse.message: She examines the specimen at length. A long pause. "This is rare — genuinely rare." She pays without haggling. -1 {{key}} · +{{reward}} cr · +{{rep}} rep.

survivante.label: 🤝 Survival trade
survivante.message: She trades without a word. -1 {{key}} · +2 Medicine · +15 HP.

ally: I missed you, in a way.
friendly: Welcome back. Want something to drink?

folieCallback: {{name}} steps back as you approach. "You've got... dried blood. There, on your jaw." He avoids your gaze for the rest of the conversation.
{{name}} sniffs the air, uneasy. "What's that smell..." He doesn't finish the sentence.
"People say things about you," {{name}} says quietly. "The kind of things you'd rather not believe. Except now, looking at you..."
{{name}} keeps their distance, hands visible. "I'm not going to ask questions. Just be quick."

fear: {{npc}} freezes for a second. "They say {{name}} has sworn to end you. People like me avoid people like you."
"You're the one who defied {{name}}," {{npc}} murmurs, not meeting your eyes. "Do what you came for and leave."
{{npc}} steps back. "I don't want trouble with {{name}}. And you're trouble on legs."
betray: {{npc}} stares at you coldly. "Alanossa tells everyone you betrayed her. Her word carries weight here."
"I was told not to trust you," {{npc}} says. "Someone close to Alanossa. You know the type."
respect: {{npc}} nods with deference. "Word is {{name}} holds you in high regard. That opens doors around here."
"You're close to {{name}}, aren't you?" {{npc}} lowers their voice, almost respectful. "That changes things."

stalker: {{name}} lowers their voice. "Someone was asking about you earlier. Watch yourself."
{{name}} glances behind you before speaking. "Got someone on your tail?"
"You look like someone people are looking for," {{name}} says without a smile.
hurt: {{name}} watches you approach. "You've taken a beating. Shows from a mile off."
"You're still alive? Barely." {{name}} narrows their eyes.
"Sit down," {{name}} says. "You look like a dead man still walking."
famous: {{name}} recognizes you instantly. "Everyone in the sector is talking about you."
"I'd heard you'd pass through here," {{name}} says. "The sector has a memory."
badRep: {{name}} looks away. "Not sure I want to be seen with you here."
"You've got a bad reputation," {{name}} says quietly. "A few people would like to talk to you. The kind of people you'd rather avoid."
greeting.traque: {{name}} notices something. "You've been looking over your shoulder since you walked in. What's your problem?"
regular: {{name}} looks up without surprise. "You're still here. Part of the furniture now."
"You again." {{name}} says it without malice. Almost warm.
"I was half expecting you," {{name}} says. "You're predictable. Not a complaint."
greeting.day20: "You're still alive," {{name}} says. "That's something, around here."
greeting.poor: {{name}} glances at you. "You look broke. It shows."
greeting.lore: {{name}} looks at you differently. "You look like someone searching for something specific. Or someone who's already found too much."
neutral: {{name}} looks up. No enthusiasm, no hostility. They're waiting.
{{name}} sizes you up for a second, then goes back to what they were doing. They saw you.
{{name}} gives you a brief nod. The kind that says: "you're here, I saw, we're good."
{{name}} pauses for a second. Looks at you. Continues. The silence is neutral.
"Hey." {{name}} says nothing else. But they recognized you.

rival.apologizeSuccess: They listen. Their shoulders relax. 'This doesn't erase anything. But...' They leave. +20 rep.
rival.apologizeFail: {{name}} isn't ready to listen. Fight inevitable.
rival.payInsufficient: Not enough credits ({{amount}} cr required). They're done waiting.
rival.paySuccess: -{{amount}} cr. They take the money and leave. Grudges have a price.
rival.fleeSuccess: You bolt. -1 fuel. They'll be there next time.

rivalEnemyDesc: They fight with the rage of someone who's been waiting a long time.

namedNpcs.marek: He's been fixing ships for thirty years. He knows things.
namedNpcs.torvak: Sixty years of service. He's seen things he doesn't talk about anymore.
namedNpcs.lira: She knows your passwords. She doesn't use them — yet.
namedNpcs.boro: He sells things you don't need but will want anyway.
namedNpcs.cael: Alanossa's right hand. Efficient. Discreet. Deadly.
namedNpcs.neva: She's been here since it was still a real prison.
namedNpcs.pistis: He connects those who want to sell with those who'd rather not know where it came from.
namedNpcs.ganz: He runs the bets, the arenas, and the secrets of the wealthy.
namedNpcs.myrra: She commands the Scarlet Guardians at this station. She judges fast.
namedNpcs.ysla: She's searching for something in the ruins. She thinks she found it.
namedNpcs.drela: He's flown everywhere. Now he drinks and watches the stars.
namedNpcs.rook: He makes weapons. He doesn't ask questions. He gives good prices.
namedNpcs.vance: Calm. But his eyes have seen something that calm barely hides.
namedNpcs.vosh: He evaluates candidates for Alanossa. One look. One second. He's already decided.
namedNpcs.orva: She runs the fort when Ossian sleeps. Either she respects you, or you leave.
namedNpcs.besh: He guards things that belong to no one — and profits from it.
namedNpcs.ulmo: He advises those who decide. What he himself thinks, no one knows.
namedNpcs.vael: He counts the ships that pass. He doesn't let many through.
namedNpcs.kross: He knows things about everyone here. He carefully chooses what he keeps.
namedNpcs.setta: She manages the stock, the prices, and the undesirables. In that order.
namedNpcs.fenn: He knew Alanossa before she was Alanossa. He remembers it differently.
namedNpcs.torq: Discipline and loyalty. In that order. He doesn't smile often.
namedNpcs.lyss: She sees patterns in data no one else reads.
namedNpcs.mako: He runs the sector's riskiest bar with unsettling serenity.
namedNpcs.harek: He's held his post for eight years. He didn't ask to leave.
namedNpcs.sera: She's seen everything that passes through this space corridor for five years. Everything.
namedNpcs.drav: Whatever he can't fix, he hasn't met yet.
namedNpcs.keln: He commanded a Guardian garrison. He doesn't talk about it.
namedNpcs.mira-c: She smiles at everyone and remembers every price.
namedNpcs.rexx: Clean suit, chosen words. What he thinks, he keeps to himself.
namedNpcs.olin: He knows where every crate is. He also knows where some shouldn't be.
namedNpcs.sonn: She's lived here for thirty years. She's seen enough people to no longer be surprised by anything.
namedNpcs.sael: He knows everything said in this club. He'll never repeat it. Except once.
namedNpcs.murn: He was there when it burned. He's still here. There's a reason.
namedNpcs.docta: He's treated residents since the official quarantine ended. No one told him to leave.
namedNpcs.zal: He protects archives that predate the sector's collective memory.
namedNpcs.oss: His ship became a city. He adapted to it slowly.
namedNpcs.shel: If you see her, it's because she decided you could.
namedNpcs.tonn: He has an agreement with every faction. He never says how he got it.
namedNpcs.rinn: She maintains the signal. She listens to everything that passes. She notes a lot of things.
namedNpcs.broxx: He knows the prices of forty stations. He knows exactly what you're overpaying.
namedNpcs.reine: Her real name isn't known. Her authority over this port is.
namedNpcs.vael-s: He's studied gas giants for twelve years. He hasn't found what he's looking for. He continues.
namedNpcs.elenne: She watches the stars. She stopped watching people a long time ago.
namedNpcs.kaed: He's gone further than this station. Twice. He talks about it sparingly.
namedNpcs.grelm: He's led the miners since the old chief left. Nobody asks why.
namedNpcs.brenn: He manages the men, the machines, and the heat. Not necessarily in that order.
namedNpcs.kaur: Forty years in the mines. His hands are harder than the rock he cut.
